review_loop.verdict_before_address: Request Changes — 1 critical (DB1), 7 warnings (DB1), 6 warnings (CA1), 20 suggestions after dedup
findings_addressed: CRITICAL (DB1, corroborated design area): the M02 lost-release watchdog terminated every hands-free capture ~1 s after start. Fixed: the watchdog ignores hands-free captures and polls the trigger that started the capture (hotkey or mouse); regression test test_hands_free_double_tap now runs watchdog ticks.
DB1-W2 / CA1-W1 (corroborated): the startup recovery scan could terminal-corrupt a live session's jobs. Fixed: the unresolved-job loop skips jobs carrying the current boot_id.
DB1-W3: check-then-act spawn could double-spawn workers (launch warm-up vs first request). Fixed: _spawn_lock held across check-and-spawn in ensure_running and restart().
CA1-W2: engine messages lacked the generation guard hello has. Fixed: late engine messages from a dying generation are ignored.

DB1-W4: cancelling during processing unlinked the in-flight worker wav (faulting a healthy worker and burning its retry). Fixed: deletion deferred to _finishWithText_'s cancelled branch; fault handlers route cancelled jobs to the cancellation path instead of registering recoverable items. Regression tests added.

DB1-W5 / CA1-W4 (half): cleanup 'basic' policy still blocked on engine load (internal 600 s wait). Fixed: clean() uses engine_wait=0 — the worker answers basic honestly; the 'wait' policy's bounded wait_engine is now the only wait. Test added.
DB1-W6: cleanup engine reported 'ready' after a swallowed model-load failure. Fixed: worker checks TranscriptCleaner.load_failed and emits engine state 'failed' with reason cleanup_engine_failed.

DB1-W7: mouse/hotkey cross-talk and no lost-release recovery for mouse captures. Fixed: startDictation/finishDictation are trigger-source aware; MouseTriggerListener gained physically_down() via NSEvent.pressedMouseButtons; the watchdog clears the owning listener's held state.

CA1-W3: fault-event details carried raw stderr tail lines and the tail survived respawns. Fixed: _stderr_tail cleared per generation; _fault_detail is a content-free digest (line/byte counts + traceback flag).

CA1-W5: envelope mislabeled a failed audio write as consent_disabled and verify() missed dangling decode ranges. Fixed: on_audio records audio_write_failed and swallows store failures (evidence never fails dictation); envelope reasons and audio_preparation are honest; Store.verify requires a missing-reason for range blocks without a parent. Test added.
CA1-W6: failed_recoverable was written for jobs with nothing recoverable. Fixed: mic-open failure and wav-write failures now record failed_unrecoverable (state vocabulary already had it).

Suggestions applied: TAP_SEC dead constant removed; journal header carries captured_at/time_quality; journal writer uses a write-all loop; reader-EOF resolves pendings unconditionally; recovery drops below-min crash residue; cleanup_emptied_output distinct reason; cleaning state written for non-collecting jobs too; \Z regex anchor; HF_HUB_OFFLINE forced (not setdefault); dead CaptureJournal.delete_files and unreachable except removed; PCM16 readback scale 32767; redundant degraded_notice event removed; time-import shadow fixed; retryLastFailed_ guarded during recording and clears only the retried entry; tautological test assertion replaced; staleecho/wait tests added.
Tests added per reviewers: hands-free watchdog regression, retry guard, cancel wav deferral, stale-generation echo, cleanup wait/engine_wait, audio write-failure honesty.
findings_deferred: CA1-S3: framing constants (4-byte BE length, 64 MiB cap) duplicated in worker.py and supervisor.py — intentional: separate processes and IO layers; sharing would couple the protocol definition across the IPC boundary for two literals.

CA1-S11: audio write amplification (journal blk + worker wav + store artifact + optional PCM16 debug ≈ 3-4 transient copies) — accepted for M03 (each has a distinct role; journal copies deleted eagerly); hardlink optimization noted for a future milestone if it ever matters on this machine.

CA1-S12: collector.job_started (consent snapshot) stays on the release path rather than the coordinator thread — the training contract requires consent-at-capture-time; the local single-writer store answers in well under the S24 budget (hotkey p95 measured at 0.2 ms including this path).
DB1-S8 (micro): supervisor._consecutive_deaths incremented outside _state_lock — a single int under the GIL; noted.
review_loop.post_address_verification: All 13 automated suites re-run green; model-backed live pipeline 2/2, live worker 2/2 (kill -9 restart 2.0 s), cleanup 51/51; benchmark re-run on post-review code (hotkey p95 passes, queue bounded at 256, real load 2.35 s, kill9 2.05 s, RSS stable).

privacy: Nothing private entered Git: events stay content-free (fault details are now digests by mechanism, not just capped); committed artifacts carry hashes, counts and synthetic fixtures only; tests/v2/test_baseline_manifest.py privacy scan passes over the new directories; journals/wavs/recovery audio live under ~/Library/Application Support/LocalFlow/v2-journal/ (0700/0600) outside the repository, and every test/benchmark harness repaths those roots into tempdirs.
regression_requirements: PTT cancellation, clipboard fallback and FIFO processing verified green (test_stuck_overlay 5/5, lifecycle suites); no new always-on microphone behavior (wake handler starts nothing; hands-free and mouse triggers are opt-in config, default off).
